content_md:
It’s rare that I feel RAM envy, but this was one of them. It wasn’t even because I need it, my feeling was more — “they don’t need _that_ much RAM! If they do, it means I need much more.” 

Mind you I’ve never actually had any RAM issues since I switched to Macs…

The mind is silly. But I appreciate the reasoning behind using pages over textpad. 

What I really missed on a Mac was Notepad++, now there are lots of options of course and I can easily make one for myself.
